Email guides

A welcome email people want to open

By Example Studio editorial team

October 23, 2026

A welcome email should help a new subscriber take one useful next step.

Make the subject specific

Tell readers what they will get from opening the message. Match that promise in the email.

Choose one next step

Link to a useful guide or a first action. Give that link a clear label.

Keep replies connected

Use a reply address your team reads and explain how readers can ask for help.
